title: German-Style Quesadilla
description: A twist on traditional Mexican quesadillas, this recipe combines the flavors of Germany with the comfort of a cheesy tortilla.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Place a tortilla in the skillet and sprinkle shredded cheese on half of the tortilla.
Add 1/4 cup of fermented sauerkraut on top of the cheese.
Fold the tortilla in half to enclose the filling.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the tortilla is crispy and the cheese is melted.
Flip the quesadilla and cook for an additional 2 minutes or until the other side is crispy.
Cut the quesadilla into wedges and serve with a side of gooey honey mustard for dipping.
